scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic proof and a standalone prime-field enumeration; finite experiments do not certify universal statements and independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three exterior generators; characteristic different from two. Count statements require odd finite fields. General orthogonal-quadric generator geometry is classical and is not claimed as new; priority relative to unidentified broader quadratic-algebra classification is not established.
title: Maximal elementwise square-zero spaces and the associative boundary of the three-generator exterior algebra
